note: Views Base URL adds one global Views field handler, base_url ('Global: Base url'), registered on the 'views' table via hook_views_data_alter (views_base_url.views.inc). It has no settings form, no configure route (configure=null), no permissions, no Drush, and defines no plugin TYPES. The field prints RequestContext::getCompleteBaseUrl(); it can be referenced as the [base_url] token inside a Global: Custom text field, or rendered as a link via show_link + show_link_options (link_path, link_text, link_class, link_title, link_rel, link_fragment, link_query, link_target), validated by schema views.field.base_url. All state lives in the view config under the base_url field handler. Medium/hard cases are grounded in that real view config: introspection reads back a base_url field's link options; execution adds the base_url field to a view or turns it into a link with a link_path, verified against the live views.view config.

evals.prompt: In a Drupal View, I want to output the site's full base URL (like https://example.com). Using the views_base_url module, which field do I add to the view, and what is its handler/plugin id?
evals.expected_output: Add the global field 'Global: Base url' (handler/plugin id base_url), registered on the 'views' table by views_base_url. It prints the complete base URL from RequestContext::getCompleteBaseUrl().

evals.prompt: Using views_base_url, how do I build a custom absolute link like Home in a View so the href includes the site's base URL? What replacement token do I use and in which field?
evals.expected_output: Add the Global: Base url field (tick Exclude from display), then add a Global: Custom text field below it and reference [base_url], e.g. Home. Field order matters: the Custom text must come after the base_url field.

evals.prompt: The views_base_url 'Base url' field can render itself as a link instead of plain text. Which option turns that on, and name some of the link sub-options you can set (path, text, class, query, etc.)?
evals.expected_output: Tick 'Display as link' (show_link). Then set show_link_options: link_path (a Drupal path appended to the base URL), link_text, link_class, link_title, link_rel, link_fragment, link_query, link_target. Several accept {{ token }} replacement patterns.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a View with machine id 'views_base_url_intro' that uses the views_base_url 'Base url' field rendered as a link. Inspect the live view configuration and tell me the link_path configured on that field.
evals.expected_output: In views.view.views_base_url_intro the base_url field has show_link true and show_link_options.link_path = node/1.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a View with machine id 'views_base_url_style' whose views_base_url 'Base url' field is rendered as a link with a custom CSS class. Inspect the live view configuration and tell me the CSS class configured for that link.
evals.expected_output: In views.view.views_base_url_style the base_url field has show_link_options.link_class = vbu-highlight.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a View with machine id 'views_base_url_task' whose default display only shows the node title. Using the views_base_url module, add its 'Global: Base url' field to this view's default display so the view outputs the site's base URL. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: The default display of views.view.views_base_url_task gains a field handler using the base_url plugin (table views, field/id base_url).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the View 'views_base_url_link_task' already has the views_base_url 'Base url' field, but it currently renders as plain text. Configure that field to render as a link (Display as link) pointing to the Drupal path 'node/1', and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In views.view.views_base_url_link_task the base_url field gets show_link = true and show_link_options.link_path = node/1.
